svg.title: DDoS protection
svg.desc: A botnet of 30,000 IPs floods the login API at 400,000 requests a second. The CDN edge absorbs the flood and forwards only real players' requests, so the origin load stays low. A bot that tries to skip the edge and hit the origin directly is blocked by the origin firewall.
svg.text: The flood dies at the edge. Only clean traffic reaches the login API.
